== English Decipher comparison ==
The January 2002 Supplement limits the deployment permission to characters, vehicles and starships. The non-shielded planet drain trigger and both deployment exceptions are preserved. Both faces print Immediate Effect.

Decipher, 29 January 2002, [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/f/ff/Decipher_Glossary_Supplement.pdf#page=2 Glossary Supplement], PDF page 2. Players Committee, June 2017, [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/a/a0/PC-Decipher-Errata-June-2017.pdf#page=7 Decipher Errata slips], PDF page 7. Players Committee, 2023, [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/3/3d/SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf#page=106 Advanced Rulebook, Appendix A], PDF page 106.
